```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<table><thead><tr><th>Expression</th><th>Result</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>a | b</td><td>true</td></tr></tbody></table>')
puts result.inspect
```
